title: Data Infrastructure & Reverse ETL
tagline: Make the warehouse the single source of truth: resolve one customer across CRM, billing and product data, plan diff-only syncs back to the CRM, and run dbt-style models in the right order.
why: Every GTM workflow downstream (routing, scoring, AI emails, churn alerts) reads customer data. If the CRM says one thing, billing another and the product a third, every automation is wrong in a different way. A warehouse-native setup fixes this once: merge identities in SQL models, build one golden record, and push only the changed fields back into the tools the reps use.
covers: Identity resolution: union-find over normalized email (gmail dots and +tags) and phone (US/CA 11-digit), transitive merges across sources
Survivorship rules: per field, newest non-empty value wins; ties go to the higher-priority source; field-level lineage shows where each value came from
Reverse-ETL diff sync: field mapping, insert / update / unchanged / optional delete, per-field from→to changes, duplicate keys fail the run
dbt-style model DAG: run order, parallel layers, cycle and unknown-ref detection, downstream rebuild set for a changed model
gaps: No live Snowflake / BigQuery / Hightouch / Census connection: inputs are JSON rows
Matching is deterministic (exact normalized keys); no fuzzy name or address matching
No SQL parsing: model dependencies are declared, not extracted from ref() calls
